entries.note_hr: Put Malog Princa u NP Paklenica zatvoren je do daljnjeg zbog dotrajalih elemenata osiguranja i pomagala u prolasku zahtjevnoga planinarskog puta.
entries.note_en: Put Malog Princa in NP Paklenica is closed until further notice due to worn safety elements and aids on this demanding trail.

entries.note_hr: Privremena nedostupnost planinarskih putova na Dinari u mjesecu lipnju 2026.
entries.note_en: Temporary unavailability of hiking trails on Dinara during June 2026.

entries.note_hr: Mjestimice pojačana do jaka bura, uglavnom na Senjskom području. Najjači udari vjetra 35-45 čvorova (65-85 km/h).
entries.note_en: Locally strong to gale-force bora wind, mainly in the Senj area. Peak gusts 35-45 knots (65-85 km/h).
entries.gear: Windproof layer; extra caution on exposed ridgeline sections

entries.note_hr: Na oba ulaza u NP Sjeverni Velebit (Babić Siča i Alan) plaćanje ulaznica moguće je isključivo gotovinom. Ulaznice na ulazu Alan kupuju se kod dežurnog čuvara prirode. Ulaz Babić Siča radi pon-ned 8:00-16:00.
entries.note_en: Payment at both NP Sjeverni Velebit entrances (Babić Siča and Alan) is possible in cash only. Tickets at the Alan entrance are purchased from the duty nature warden. Babić Siča entrance is open Mon-Sun 08:00-16:00.
entries.gear: Carry sufficient cash for park entry fees
